sections.h2: Cereals make up 57.7% of certificates, 6,280 of 10,885

chart.title: Cereals outnumber every other crop category on the register
chart.sub: Certificates issued by crop category, as on 31 Aug 2026.

sections.means: Cereals account for 6,280 of 10,885 certificates, more than any other crop category.
sections.todo: Treat the category boundaries as approximate, since the Authority publishes no methodology note.

sections.h2: Farmers hold 49.3% of certificates, just under half

chart.title: Farmer registrations are just under half of the 10,885 total
chart.sub: Certificates issued by registration type, as on 31 Aug 2026.
chart.source: PPV&FR Authority registration-type chart, captured 31 Aug 2026.

sections.means: Farmers hold 5,368 of 10,885 certificates, so the farmer route is real but not a majority.
sections.todo: Quote the 49.3% share from the Authority's own chart, not the 52.6% figure from an uncorroborated snippet.

sections.means: Spices appear only as a dated July snapshot of 151 certificates, while cereals stand at 6,280 in August.
